direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.question: How much does composite bonding cost per tooth in Cork?
direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.answer: Composite bonding in Cork typically costs €150 to €350 per tooth. Edge bonding on the biting edge alone is €150 to €180 per tooth, while a full composite veneer covering the front surface is €250 to €350 per tooth.

direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.question: How much is composite bonding for 6 front teeth in Cork?
direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.answer: Treating the six upper front teeth typically comes to €900 to €2,100 in Cork, and eight teeth come to €1,200 to €2,800.

direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.question: What is the difference between edge bonding and a composite veneer?
direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.answer: Edge bonding adds tooth-coloured resin only to the biting edge or corners of the tooth to fix chips or wear. A full composite veneer layers resin across the entire visible front surface to change both colour and shape.

direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.question: Does composite bonding damage your natural tooth enamel?
direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.answer: In most cases no drilling of healthy tooth structure is needed. The surface is cleaned and lightly conditioned with a mild gel so the resin bonds microscopically to your enamel.

direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.question: How long does composite bonding last before needing a polish or repair?
direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.answer: Composite bonding typically lasts 5 to 7 years with good home care and a routine six-monthly hygienist polish. Edge repairs if a corner chips take one short appointment.

direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.question: Should I whiten my teeth before getting composite bonding?
direct_answer_faqs_for_seeding.answer: Yes. Whitening gels lighten natural tooth enamel but do not change the colour of composite resin. Always complete your dentist-supervised whitening first and wait 10 to 14 days before shade-matching the bonding.
